g.text: Verify at creation, release and operation
Different checkpoints expose different defects; a checker’s effectiveness also needs evidence.
Guide goals, standards andconstraints; inspect generated workfor local issues.
Another model’s agreement or quickhuman approval does not supplyindependent correctness evidence.
Test interfaces, permissions, financialinvariants and broader regressions.
Retain reproducible test evidence;assess what important defects thechecker actually detects.
Reproduce escaped failures, verify repairsagainst other work and retain rollback.
Prevention remains a priority; detectionand response remain necessary.No self-healing result is established.
Use these as a design checklist. Their conceptual product is not a calibrated confidence score or probability.

The three loops come from Sonar’s official abstract; the four factors and over-reliance concerns come from notes.The code-size example lacks benchmark conditions; no universal 50K-line limit or defect-rate formula is inferred.
Source: Sonar notes/program. A passing suite or fail-leaning judge cannot establish coverage of every consequential failure.
